summary: Performance is excellent (frame median ~0.8 ms, p95 2 ms, 30 fps) and the island looks pleasant, but the scene is cluttered with overlapping labels, the camera is cramped, and the side panel is truncated and stale.

findings.what: Name labels and speech bubbles overlap and get cut off (e.g. 'Sprout' behind a creature, '*takes…' overlapping 'Spr…ffle', 'Wibble' clipped at the viewport edge). They are unreadable whenever creatures are close together, and are drawn through other objects.
findings.suggestion: Offset labels above the head with a small background plate, stagger or hide overlapping ones, clamp to the viewport, and show bubbles only for the nearest or focused creature.

findings.what: The free camera sits very close to the ground and creatures, so one big creature fills the frame and tree crowns/trunks block the view. Most of the island and the other creatures are not visible, which makes the world hard to read at a glance. This matches the open todo 'creatures are hidden behind tree crowns'.
findings.evidence: world/reviews/fe8-1.png (creature and trunk fill the frame)
findings.suggestion: Pull the default camera back and up, auto-frame the group of creatures, and fade or cull tree crowns that occlude creatures.

findings.what: Scene is dark and low-contrast at 20:xx. Shadows cover most of the grass and the small props (flowers, stones) are hard to make out; dark creatures like the sheep's face disappear. The 'Pretty night' todo is still open.
findings.suggestion: Raise ambient/fill light and add a blue moon tint, with rim light on creatures so they stay readable.

findings.what: The right panel text is truncated with ellipses ('review: needs_work: Flies are shown to render and t…', 'Light change in scenery.jl: sun/moon intensit…', todo lines cut off), so the human cannot read the reviewer verdict, the messages or the todos. The status line also still says 'a reviewer checks the last work' and did not change over 16 s.
findings.where: Right panel (Sprout / Messages / Next on the list)
findings.evidence: world/reviews/fe8-1.png and fe8-3.png, identical panel text
findings.suggestion: Wrap long lines or allow expanding them, give the panel scrolling or a detail view, and update the status when the review ends.

findings.what: The mini game state is unclear. The header says 'playing: Jump in (WASD)' with a Stop button, but nothing in the viewport shows a player, score or goal. Firefly catch is the only mini game and it is not visible in either screenshot.
findings.where: Header bar and mini game controls
findings.suggestion: Show an on-screen HUD (score, objective, controls) while playing and highlight the player character.

findings.what: The world feels sparse and static: only 10 creatures, 0 actors, no systems, one plugin. Little visible activity happens between the screenshots.
findings.suggestion: Add ambient activity such as fireflies, wandering creatures with visible goals, and weather or time-of-day events.
